info.title: Pishkhan Panel API
info.description: Contract owned by the backend (overview section 6). Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details whose `errors` hold message keys.

post.summary: Send a login code by SMS
post.description: Rate limited per phone (5/hour), per IP (20/hour) and with a 60 s resend cooldown. Requires an ALTCHA payload unless disabled.

post.summary: Verify the login code and start a session
Sign in with phone and password (and TOTP when enabled)
Rotate the refresh token
post.description: Every call returns a new refresh token. Reusing an old one revokes the whole session.

post.summary: Exchange a one-time support-session token (from the back office link) for a 30-minute access token
post.description: The token works once and for 2 minutes. The session has no refresh token; `POST /auth/logout` ends it. Under it, password, TOTP and session changes (and other sensitive actions) answer 403 `auth.support_session.not_allowed`.

post.summary: End the current session
Issue a 5-minute token for the SignalR hub

get.summary: Current user

put.summary: Set or change the optional password

get.summary: Active sessions

post.summary: Start TOTP setup; returns the secret for the authenticator app
Confirm TOTP setup with a code
Turn TOTP off (requires a current code)
Create a workspace; the caller becomes its owner

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Workspaces the caller belongs to

post.summary: Accept an invitation (signed in with the invited phone)

get.summary: Workspace details

post.summary: Ask to delete the workspace (owner); its data is deleted after 30 days unless cancelled
post.description: `confirmName` must equal the workspace name. Members lose access at once and automations stop; the workspace stays in `GET /workspaces` with status `pending_deletion` and `deletionScheduledFor`.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending deletion (owner); the workspace is active again

get.summary: Business hours (Asia/Tehran) and closed dates
Team members

post.summary: Invite a team member by phone (SMS link)
post.description: Members and pending invitations count against the plan's `seats`; over the limit answers 402 `billing.plan_limit`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Pending invitations (not yet accepted or expired), newest first

delete.summary: Revoke a pending invitation; its link stops working

post.summary: Upload a file into quarantine; it is scanned before use
post.description: multipart/form-data with one part named `file` and query `purpose`. Returns 202; status becomes clean, infected, rejected or scan_failed. Only clean files have URLs.

get.summary: File status and, when clean, a 5-minute download URL
Connected channel accounts

post.summary: Start connecting an Instagram professional account
post.description: Returns the Instagram authorization URL. The browser is sent back to the panel after the callback with `status=connected|denied|error` and `reason` (`plan_limit` when a new account would exceed the plan's `channel_accounts`). 402 `billing.plan_limit` when the plan's accounts are all in use and none needs reconnecting.

get.summary: Recent posts and reels of an Instagram account, newest first
get.description: For post-specific rules. `cursor` comes from the previous page; `limit` is 1 to 50 (default 25). Read live from Instagram.

delete.summary: Disconnect a channel account; its token is erased

get.summary: Whether Instagram is working, for the outage banner

post.summary: Connect a Bale bot by its token
post.description: Checks the token with Bale, registers the webhook and returns the account. 422 `channels.bale_token_invalid`, 409 `channels.bale_bot_taken` (connected to a workspace already), 402 `billing.plan_limit`, 503 `channels.bale_unavailable`.

get.summary: Conversations, most recent customer message first
get.description: Filters: `status`, `assignee` (`me`, `none` or a user id), `channelAccountId`, `unread=true`, `q` (customer name or username, or a phone or email the customer gave). Keyset pagination: pass `cursor` from the previous page.

get.summary: Messages, newest first, keyset paginated by (created_at, id)

post.summary: Send a reply as a team member
post.description: Queues the reply (202) and sends it in the background; the status arrives as `message.status`. Outside the 24-hour window a reply within 7 days of the customer's last message goes out with the HUMAN_AGENT tag; later than that it is refused with `conversation.window_closed`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

post.summary: Assign to a team member, or unassign with `assigneeId: null`
Change status: open, pending, handed_off or closed
post.description: `handed_off` also pauses the AI and notifies the team.

post.summary: Pause or resume the AI agent for this conversation
Mark the conversation read for the team

get.summary: Internal notes, oldest first

post.summary: Add an internal note (never sent to the customer)

get.summary: Saved replies, by shortcut
Contacts, newest first; filter by text (name, username, phone, email), tag, segment, channel account, phone or consent
A contact with their conversations

patch.summary: Change a contact's name, tags or fields

get.summary: Tags defined or in use, by name

put.summary: Define a tag or change its colour and description

delete.summary: Remove a tag from every contact and delete its definition

post.summary: Rename a tag on every contact; renaming onto an existing tag merges them

get.summary: Custom fields, in display order

put.summary: Change a field's label, type, options or order (the key stays)

delete.summary: Delete a field definition; contacts keep their values

get.summary: Saved segments with their current contact counts

post.summary: Count the contacts a rule matches, without saving it

get.summary: The contact's form submissions, newest first
The contact's consent per channel and its history

post.summary: Record that the contact granted or withdrew consent for a channel
Export the contacts matching the filters to Excel, in the background

get.summary: The caller's exports, newest first

post.summary: A download URL for a ready export, valid 5 minutes and issued once (409 crm.export.not_ready or crm.export.gone otherwise)

get.summary: Flows that collected answers, most recently submitted first
A flow's submissions, newest first
get.description: 404 when the flow is not in this workspace and has no submissions here (a deleted flow keeps its submissions).

get.summary: How many contacts a campaign would reach, and whether one may be sent now

post.summary: Text every contact who agreed to SMS, inviting them to another channel

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Campaigns, newest first
One campaign's progress

post.summary: A one-time link to the shop's Bale bot for this contact (send it on Instagram or by SMS)

get.summary: Rules, highest priority first

post.summary: Create a rule
post.description: Triggers: dm_keyword, comment_keyword, comment_any, story_reply, story_mention, live_comment, post_share, new_conversation, postback, outside_business_hours. Keyword matching ignores Arabic/Persian letter variants, digits, spacing and half-spaces.

post.summary: Reply to the post's existing comments
post.description: Pages through the comments of the rule's post and answers those within Meta's 7-day private reply limit, paced like live comments. Comments already answered are skipped. One run per rule at a time (409).

get.summary: How often the rule fired and replied, per day (UTC), for the last `days` (default 30)

post.summary: Create a flow (draft)

put.summary: Edit the draft; published versions do not change until the next publish

post.summary: Validate the draft without publishing
Publish the draft as a new version
post.description: Runs already in progress keep the version they started on. An invalid draft is refused with 422 and the validation result.

put.summary: AI on or off, fallback message
put.description: The outside-business-hours trigger and flow conditions use the workspace's business hours (`/workspaces/{workspaceId}/business-hours`).

get.summary: Scheduled follow-ups, soonest first for pending ones and newest first otherwise

post.summary: Cancel a pending follow-up
Dry-run the rules against a sample message or comment
post.description: Shows which rule would answer (or the AI, the fallback, nothing) and what it would send, with variables filled in. Nothing is sent or stored, and cooldowns are ignored.

post.summary: Dry-run a flow with sample answers
post.description: Runs the draft (or `published`) from its start, then feeds `answers` one at a time while it waits for input. Delays end at once. An invalid draft is refused with 422 and the validation result.

delete.summary: Delete a category; its products keep no category

get.summary: Products, most recently changed first
get.description: Filters: `q` (title, description and tags, Persian normalized), `categoryId`, `tag`, `status`. Cursor pagination.

put.summary: Replace a product and its variants

post.summary: Add an image to the end of a product's images
post.description: `fileId` is a Files upload with purpose `product_image`. Adding an image the product already has changes nothing. At most 10 images.

delete.summary: Remove an image from a product

put.description: `fileIds` must list every image of the product exactly once; the first is the cover.

get.summary: The catalog as an Excel sheet (Persian headers, one row per variant, prices in Toman)
An empty import sheet with the headers and one example row

post.summary: Import an Excel sheet uploaded with purpose `import_sheet`
post.description: The file must be clean (scanned). Rows are matched by `شناسه محصول`, then by `کد کالا`; other rows create products. Rows with errors are skipped and listed in the result. Poll `GET /catalog/imports/{id}`.

post.summary: Create a card set: up to 10 products sent as a carousel by rules (`send_cards`)

get.summary: The cards as customers will see them: active products only, texts cut to Instagram's limits

post.summary: Preview a bulk price change
post.description: Nothing is saved. 422 `catalog.price_change_too_large` when more than 5,000 products match.

post.summary: Apply a bulk price change as one batch
post.description: The result is exactly the preview for the same request. 409 `catalog.price_change_stale` when the fingerprint no longer matches; 422 `catalog.price_change_empty` when no price changes, `catalog.price_change_below_zero` when a price would reach zero, `catalog.price_change_too_large`. Cards, the AI's knowledge and caches are refreshed at once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Recent bulk price changes, newest first (50)
A bulk price change with every price it changed

post.summary: Undo a bulk price change within 24 hours
post.description: Puts back every price that still has the batch's new value; prices changed since are left alone (`undoSkipped`). 409 `catalog.price_change_undone` or `catalog.price_change_undo_expired`.

get.summary: Orders, newest first

post.summary: Create a draft order
post.description: Catalog lines are priced from the catalog (active products, in stock). Custom lines need `title` and `unitPrice`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: The provinces of Iran with their larger cities (the capital first)

post.summary: Split a pasted address into province, city, postal code and mobile

put.summary: Replace a draft order's lines, fees and details
put.description: Only a draft can be edited (409 `orders.not_editable`); move an order awaiting payment back to `draft` to change it.

post.summary: Move an order to another status
post.description: Allowed moves are the order's `nextStatuses` (409 `orders.status_move_invalid` otherwise). `awaiting_payment` needs items and a total above zero. Paying takes stock; cancelling, refunding or returning a paid order puts it back.

post.summary: Add a note to the order's timeline

get.summary: Everything that happened to the order, oldest first
The order as an invoice: Jalali dates, Persian digits, amounts in Toman
The workspace's payment gateway account

put.summary: Connect or update the workspace's Zarinpal merchant account

delete.summary: Disconnect the merchant account; open payment links stop working

post.summary: Create a payment link for an order
post.description: A complete draft moves to `awaiting_payment`. The link is for the order's total now; a newer link cancels older ones, and the order going back to draft or being cancelled cancels it. 422 `payments.merchant_missing` without an enabled merchant account; 409 `orders.not_payable`; 400 `orders.incomplete`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: The order's payment links, newest first

post.summary: Cancel an active payment link

get.summary: The workspace's plan and its limits
get.description: Without a subscription the workspace is on the free plan. During the beta plans are granted by the Pishkhan team.

get.summary: Usage this billing period against the plan's limits
get.description: Every meter: ai_conversations, ai_messages, receipt_verifications and sms count this period; channel_accounts and seats (members plus pending invitations) are current counts.

get.summary: Plans on sale, in display order, with what buying each would be for this workspace

post.summary: What buying a plan costs now, and when it would start
post.description: 404 `billing.plan.not_found`; 422 `billing.checkout.plan_not_for_sale` or `billing.checkout.cycle_not_offered`; 409 `billing.checkout.managed_subscription` (a plan granted by the Pishkhan team without an end) or `billing.checkout.scheduled_pending` (an upgrade while a later period is already paid for).

post.summary: Buy, renew or upgrade: opens the payment at Zarinpal
post.description: The same errors as the quote, plus 422 `billing.checkout.unavailable` (online payment is not set up) and `billing.checkout.gateway_unavailable` (Zarinpal did not answer; try again). The subscription starts when Zarinpal confirms the payment.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Checkouts and invoices, newest first (100)
One checkout; a paid one is the invoice
Knowledge sources, newest first; filter by kind, text or status

post.summary: Add a FAQ, a text, an uploaded document or a web page; it is indexed in the background

put.summary: Change a source; a changed text is re-indexed

delete.summary: Delete a FAQ, text, document or page with its chunks (product sources follow the catalog)

post.summary: Build the source's chunks and embeddings again (a web page is fetched again)
What the AI would retrieve for a question (debug)

get.summary: Unanswered questions, most recently asked first; status defaults to open

post.summary: Answer once: the answer is saved as a FAQ and the question is marked answered
Hide a question that needs no answer (it opens again if asked again)

get.summary: The knowledge score (0–100), the required facts still missing and what to do next

post.summary: Turn the owner's answer to a required fact into a FAQ draft; nothing is saved
Save the approved FAQ for a required fact (replacing the fact's earlier FAQ) and return the new score
Read the newest posts of an Instagram account into product and FAQ suggestions

get.summary: The last 20 imports, newest first
An import and its suggestions, pending first

post.summary: Accept a suggestion: a catalog product, or an enabled FAQ
Accept several suggestions (up to 100)
Reject a suggestion

get.summary: Industry templates the workspace can apply, its own industry's first
What applying the template would add

post.summary: Apply an industry template
post.description: Adds the template's FAQs (switched off), flows (published), rules (switched off) and, when the workspace has none, the AI agent profile. Applying again adds only what the workspace never had; nothing it changed or deleted is touched.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID; retries with the same key return the first response.

get.summary: Templates applied to the workspace, newest first
The AI agent's persona, guardrails and handoff rules (defaults until saved)
What the agent did for each customer turn, newest first; filter by conversation or outcome
One trace: classification, retrieved facts, tool calls, guard issues, confidence and usage

post.summary: Test mode: what the AI agent would answer, with its trace (nothing is sent or stored)

get.summary: The workspace's audit log, newest first (owner only)
get.description: Actions by staff (support access) show as actor "support", without the staff member's identity or address.

get.summary: The caller's notifications (newest first) and the unread count
get.description: `unread=true` lists only unread ones. Kinds: `handoff`, `automation`, `channel`; others may appear later.

post.summary: Mark one notification read
Mark all the caller's notifications in this workspace read

get.summary: The caller's notification settings, one entry per kind

put.description: SMS can be turned on only for kinds with `smsAvailable`; at most one SMS per kind every 30 minutes is sent.

get.summary: The VAPID public key for subscribing this browser
get.description: 404 `push.unavailable` when web push is not configured on the server.

get.summary: The caller's subscribed browsers

put.summary: Subscribe this browser (send it again whenever the browser renews it)
put.description: The endpoint must be https on a known push service (400 `validation.push.endpoint`). The same endpoint again updates it. At most 10 browsers per user; the oldest is replaced.

delete.summary: Unsubscribe a browser by its endpoint (on sign-out or when the user turns push off)

get.summary: Dashboard: activity over `range` (today, 7d, 30d), the overnight summary, the inbox now and channel health
get.description: Period counts come from hourly rollups and may lag a few minutes; `inbox` and `channels` are live. Days are Tehran days.

bearer.description: User access token (sent by the BFF)
